sources.title: Bankai: Kilobyte-Scale Patches for 1-Bit LLMs via XOR Adaptation
sources.snippet: Bankai is the first post-training adaptation method for true 1-bit large language models. Released on April 2, 2026, it uses bitwise XOR operations on binary weights to create kilobyte-scale patches that modify model behavior with zero inference overhead.
